target_account.description: The source account for withdrawal deduction.

memo.description: The memo or tag for the destination address (if required by the asset).

guid.description: A unique identifier for the withdrawal request (max 36 characters).

gateway_name.description:
The gateway name (chain/network) identifier, e.g., "Ethereum", "BinanceSmartChain", "Tron", "Mixin".

This specifies which blockchain network to use for the withdrawal. Available gateways depend on the asset.
